test_function:
public void testNodeSetReturn() {
        assertXPathValueIterator(
            context,
            "test:nodeSet()/name",
            list("Name 1", "Name 2"));

        assertXPathValueIterator(
            context,
            "test:nodeSet()",
            list(testBean.getBeans()[0], testBean.getBeans()[1]));

        assertXPathPointerIterator(
            context,
            "test:nodeSet()/name",
            list("/beans[1]/name", "/beans[2]/name"));
            
        assertXPathValueAndPointer(
            context,
            "test:nodeSet()/name",
            "Name 1",
            "/beans[1]/name");        

        assertXPathValueAndPointer(
            context,
            "test:nodeSet()/@name",
            "Name 1",
            "/beans[1]/@name");
    }
